reason: Review/verify entry checklist: confirm P2 changes stay within frontend package locks and correct child-spec ownership.
Verify editor mutation flush/revision/token rules, IME safety, command panels, and Workbench regression against Workbench contract.
Verify Asset Hub navigation, save-before-leave, session rehydrate on return, and P0/P1 lifecycle regression.
Verify a11y, focus, dialog Cancel-first, Phosphor-only icons, solid surfaces, no glass/dead nav/filler copy on new panels.
Verify no optimistic domain writes, op-token/reconnect invalidation, and that app reducer does not absorb asset form databases.
Verify unit/integration/E2E coverage, static visual locks, and AC-aligned quality gates before closeout.
Verify all new Engine calls use generated types and typed fakes; no cast-all or string method names.
Verify new modules land under approved renderer directories (workbench/, assets/, state/, e2e) per package layout.
